subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should OpenClaw merge this scoped fix for channel-bearing Matrix DM scopes while deliberately retaining the known case-folded `per-peer` transcript-isolation risk tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102313?
rationale: The implementation can preserve compatibility for the two keyed scopes without changing the channel-agnostic persisted `per-peer` shape, but deciding whether that partial security mitigation is acceptable versus requiring a broader isolation redesign is a maintainer-owned boundary decision.

options.title: Merge the scoped mitigation
options.body: Land the fix for `per-channel-peer` and `per-account-channel-peer`, retain the documentation warning, and keep the canonical per-peer issue open.

options.title: Require complete scope coverage
options.body: Pause this PR until a separately approved design makes `per-peer` distinguish case-sensitive principals without breaking its cross-channel contract.

recommendation.title: Merge the scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Land the fix for `per-channel-peer` and `per-account-channel-peer`, retain the documentation warning, and keep the canonical per-peer issue open.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior review precisely framed the session-key contract and the unresolved per-peer boundary, making them the strongest available routing candidate for this decision.
